resources.string: The Earth from orbit in real time: day and night, seasons, Sun, Moon, stars and aurora.
The Earth from orbit, drawn in real time: the real day and night line, the seasons, the Sun, the Moon with its phase, stars and the aurora. Works offline and needs no permissions.

Changes apply at once when Earth Live is your wallpaper.
How much of the screen width the Earth fills.
How long the camera needs for one lap around the Earth.
The latitude the camera circles at. North shows the northern aurora, south the southern one.
The moving cloud layer (also switches off cirrus).
Thin high clouds above the main layer.
The lights of cities on the night side.
Northern and southern lights around the poles.
The faint green glow along the night limb and glowing night clouds near the poles.
Flashes inside thunderstorms on the night side.
5 fps is the most frugal (the motion is slow, but steps are visible), 10 fps is smooth enough for most. Higher is smoother and costs noticeably more power.
How bright the stars are; they are always drawn as sharp points.
How fast the cloud layer drifts around the Earth.
The picture is drawn at this share of your screen\'s resolution and stretched. Lower is easier on the battery and a little softer.
Smooths the edges of the clouds (anti-aliasing). Switching it off saves some power.
